collision_findings.issue: Candidate r1 used stable non-URN artifact_id values, conflicting with WBG v1.0.0's required versioned URN convention.
collision_findings.repair: v1.0.1 sync contract keeps versioned artifact_id and adds artifact_family_id for stable cross-version identity.

collision_findings.issue: The v1.0.0 bind template validates an exact 11-member v1.0.0 package and cannot by itself bind the new hierarchy/extensions.
collision_findings.repair: Added Hierarchical Bind Profile wrapper; the legacy bind template remains baseline owner and is not modified.

collision_findings.issue: Candidate r1 Anti-Plagiarism Check and Gate had circular required dependencies.
collision_findings.repair: Check has no Gate dependency; Gate depends one-way on Check.

collision_findings.issue: Check/Gate body capability names did not exactly match their registration capability names.
Existing Source/Authorship and provenance rules overlap conceptually with anti-plagiarism.
collision_findings.repair: No ownership conflict: baseline owns source/authorship/provenance discipline; anti-plagiarism owns source-comparison classification and originality disposition.

collision_findings.issue: Publisher persona and Publisher diagnostic cover publication readiness and pre-publication checks.
collision_findings.repair: No ownership conflict: those are advisory evaluation/purview functions; Copyright Page Creator and AI Use Disclosure Creator own concrete publication artifact generation.

collision_findings.issue: User Artistic Authority could be misread as allowing an originality gate result to be artistically overridden.
collision_findings.repair: Gate now states User Artistic Authority cannot falsify provenance, remove required attribution, or turn known source dependence into an originality PASS.

functional_capability_collision_result: PASS — no unresolved duplicate functional owner after repairs
